summary: A flat-to-firm start is likely after Friday's 1.3% rebound: GIFT Nifty is little changed, Wall Street ended higher, but Asia is mixed and foreign selling continues.

detail.leaders: Results plays: Poonawalla, DMart; order wins
detail.tone: After Friday's broad rebound (Nifty 22,520.45, +1.3%), GIFT Nifty was at 22,621, up 18.5 points, at 7:36 am, pointing to a quiet open. Kospi fell 2.22% on West Asia worries; Japan is shut for a holiday.
